# Well-planning report outline (generated by `report`)

0. Cover: well, study, revision, readiness label (`NOT READY` / `SCREENING - FOR REVIEW`), SYNTHETIC stamp when applicable, human-review statement.
1. Executive summary and recommended concept (answer first, from the numbers).
2. Design basis, sources, assumptions and standards (source register counts, standards register - all TO_VERIFY until verified).
3. Reservoir and fluid description (inputs, EOS, characterisation limits).
4. Alternatives and selection rationale (scorecard, weights, Pareto, tornado, decision tree).
5. Performance calculations and operating envelopes (nodal, profiles or injectivity, envelope table and chart, deliverability profile).
6. Trajectory, drilling, completion and integrity interfaces (schematic, trajectory, ratings, APB, movement, barrier schematics, UNRESOLVED interface specifications).
7. Flow-assurance and operational assessments (hydrate, inhibitor, cooldown, loading, erosion, wax, scale, transient: each labelled).
8. Risks, uncertainties, data gaps and follow-up (gap register, risk matrix and register, open actions).
9. Cost and schedule (only what is supplied; Gantt with whiskers; time-depth).
10. Validation evidence and calculation records (capability ledger, Java follow-ups, re-run script).
11. Appendices: drawings register, decision and action log, hand-off register.
12. Revision control.
